newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania shilling ends week weaker against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania shilling ends week weaker against dollar.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling ended the week weaker against on Friday the dollar but traders said they were unconcerned because the move was in line with expectations.
The Bank of Tanzania (BoT) said on Friday the shilling traded at a commercial mean rate of 599.9796 to the dollar compared to Thursday's 599.9400 and 599.4450 a week ago.
Against the pound, the shilling strengthened slightly to 976.1698 on Friday compared to Thursday's mean of 979.6451.
"In the short term the shilling should continue to depreciate slowly. There's no concern, we're comfortable with the rate, said a dealer. "The market is quite flat now."
Other traders said the central bank intervened during the week, selling dollars.
